text: The service is not only great but the employees are kind and friendly as well!
Always a good experience. Been consistent for so long it feels unbelievable.
They are always good. The food has always been perfect. And they have excellent service and I have never been disappointed. Will always continue coming here.
Hidden gem. Always a good meal. Very courteous!
Easily the best, most authentic Mexican restaurant in town. It’s not fancy, but it is tasty. Whenever someone from out of town comes to visit, I always take them here.
My favorite Mexican place!  I love this family.

This is by far my favorite Mexican restaurant anywhere.  Perfect salsa.  The food is consistently delicious.  Large portions served HOT. Our favorites are the steak fajitas and the carnitas.  We found this by accident the day after we moved to c’ville 10 years ago and we’re still at the hotel before moving into our house.  Back then the parking lot looked a little rough from lack of care from the shopping center owner.  We took a chance on it and were pleasantly surprised in the “hole in the wall” restaurant and have been coming ever since.  Fast service, good food, consistent quality.  I’m craving it right now just writing about it.  Highly recommend.
Delicious Mexican food, various menu options
These guys make amazing Mexican food. A regular takeaway spot for me. I usually go for chicken items. I love it.
This is my home
Pretty nice place, good portions and food came at a good speed

Wonderful! Food is delicious

Our favorite Mexican restaurant in Charlottesville. The food and service is always fantastic. We got the Huevos Rancheros and Enchiladas Rancheras with beef. We keeping coming back.

Really good authentic Mexican food.

El Puerto has been a family favorite for years. The food is great and the staff are wonderful. We’ve left town to live elsewhere a couple of times and El Puerto has always been top of our list to return to on vacations. Now we are back we are so happy it continues to thrive and we get to continue coming!
I always have a great experience an El Puerto. Food is great and price is right. Take a date and get the Fajitas for Two!

Hands-down my favorite mexican restaurant and a must-visit whenever I'm in Charlottesville for work. The food is incredible, service is terrific, and price cannot be beaten. Some of the best food available in the city at an amazing value.
Best staff ever they make me feel like family every time. In my 10+ years as a customer the food has always been delicious and the atmosphere always warm and vibrant.

One of the best Mexican restaurants in Virginia. We love about two hours away and still sometimes make the trek to eat here. Its not the cleanest or most up to date, but if you arent worried about that, you will leave full.
Great food, exceptional service. The chicken chimichanga was superb and the Spanish rice was awesome. Highly recommend.
Food was good & server was friendly
The pollo loco was delicious! Buttery grilled chicken with a sauce that's on the spicy side.
Excellent food and service.
I asked for 3 al pastor and I guess they ran out and mixed in asada with my “Al pastor tacos”. Funny.

Coming from a big ol’ Texas boy, El Puerto is unmatched across all categories. I eat here every week and am met with the same friendly faces, remembering both me and my order. The food without fail makes me a happy fella and fills me up every time. Not to mention, it’s the best value Mexican food in the city.
Best chori pollo

I was extremely upset to find out there was a 12% convenience fee added to my bill for paying with a card instead of cash! I'm not sure how this is even legal, but I'm not going back. Would have been nice if they had at least mentioned this before I ordered! The food wasn't even that good.
Great food as well as great service. Also reasonably priced
Good food

El Puerto is the kind of hidden gem that warms your heart! The food there is simply spectacular, with flavors so authentic that you travel without ever leaving the table.
You know that comforting feeling of a Sunday lunch? Well, the taste is so homemade and carefully prepared that it even tastes like grandma’s cooking—made with the kind of love you just don't find everywhere, everything is impeccable. Without a doubt, it’s the go-to spot for anyone looking for a truly authentic and welcoming Mexican experience in Charlottesville.
Servers were ok, but the food was really bad, couldn't eat most of it, and then I got stomach issues.
Good food good staff
Great food. Great service
Love this place. 10/10
Food was amazing and very tasty
Incredible job on the food, delivery, and atmosphere. It was absolutely delicious and hot on a very cold bitter day, so yeah it was very welcome.  Mucho Gracias.
I had combination platter 19 (burrito, chalupa, taco) and my partner had the burrito Mexicano. Both were generous portions with fresh ingredients. Service was attentive.

In addition to their wonderful food, El Puerto has excellent staff and customer service. When there was an issue with my food delivery, their team wasted no time in helping me get my food and treated me with such respect throughout the entire process. I recommend El Puerto to everyone in Charlottesville!

Nice friendly servers. Convenient location with good parking.

We were passing through Charlottesville traveling and were starving. We found your place on Google and decided to give it a try. Amazing food and excellent service. Loved the chips and salsa. And my meal and my husband's was delicious. I highly recommend stopping by this little hidden gem if you are hungry. Thanks for the meal.

El Puerto is what Guadalajara wishes it was. This place has good service and excellent food especially for the price.

Get the chicken soup and thank me later.

El Puerto is an absolute gem—unassuming from the outside, but once you step in, you're greeted with warm, consistent hospitality that makes every visit feel like coming home. The service here is always attentive without being overbearing, and the food speaks for itself.

The Steak Ranchero is a standout: reasonably priced, packed with bold umami flavor, and spicy enough to make your taste buds dance without overpowering the dish. Every bite is deeply satisfying.

They start you off with free chips and an incredibly fresh homemade salsa that sets the tone perfectly. Pair your meal with the guava soda—it’s fruity, fizzy, and just the right amount of sweet. For dessert, don’t skip the flan. It’s wonderfully sweet, smooth, and jiggly—just the way it should be.

El Puerto delivers amazing value and flavor in a cozy, welcoming environment. Highly recommended.
Todo bueno 👍
Awesome staff.  Wonderful food!!!  Don't let the appearance fool you - this is the REAL DEAL!

Honestly disappointing. The tacos were bland, the rice was dry, and the salsa tasted like something from a jar. Nothing tasted fresh or authentic — definitely not worth the price. Cramped too. Sadly, I won’t be coming back.
Staff was alright but the food was awful the beef was mushy and looked like pedigree dog food !
Staff was alright
FAST lunch service. Great flavors, good Mexican food.
This place deserves 5 stars for quality service and price. Love this places it's my go to. Loveeeee the ranchero sauce yum

Excellent service! Best tamales!

It's really hard to write a Mexican restaurant review because we lived 7 miles from the border for 15 years. This places does the best they can with what you can get here, I bet. The food was ok. I got a combo plate that ended up being all ground beef items and my husband got combo plate with a tamal (tomale) that was pretty dry and a chicken enchilada that was delicious! Loved the mild flavors for our daughter but missed the distinct Mexican flavors of Mexican food in Mexico! Here is my issue with this place, and tell me if I'm wrong because we just moved here - We were charged 16% in taxes. When we asked for the bill it was what we ordered, plus 16% dining tax. When we asked, they said 12% plus 4% for card tax even though we hadn't even showed a method of payment. I don't know if they would have taken off the 4% had we had cash. If all seemed a little sketchy but maybe that's how it works around here...?
They have a kids menu with a good selection!
Excellent homey restaurant with kind staff and good prices.
I go here all the time, often alone. It’s always delicious. You can’t go wrong on the window. Servers are kind and prices are reasonable. Grateful I found this place!
A decent Mexican restaurant. My Arroz Con Pollo was very bland. I will probably search from something better next time. This one was very close to the hotel we were staying at.
One of the best Mexican restaurants I have ever been to. Quick seating, tortilla chips, great menu, big portions reasonable prices. Can’t beat it

El Puerto is a nice local restaurant serving Mexican food at reasonable prices. We tried the chicken and beef tacos, and both were good. The tortillas were nice and soft, while the meat was tender. The portions were good and the service was friendly and quick. Overall, a good choice for a casual meal. Recommended!
Best food 30 years in a row!

The flavor of the food is really good and exquisite. You can enjoy and taste on every bits.. We LOVE this place.

The mole is superb and the special burrito, according to my dining partner, is indeed special. It's busy at lunchtime and the options are numerous. The service is always friendly and warm.
Quick and courteous staff, quality food and good portions.

My favorite Mexican restaurant in town! It’s tucked away in a strip mall making it a hidden gem. Love their food, prices are more affordable than some of the other spots, generous portions and great service.

Hands down THE BEST authentic Mexican restaurant in Charlottesville.

Prices are SUPERB.
Portions are SUPERB.
Service is SUPERB.

Where else are you getting 5 tacos for $6 or a platter of fajitas with rice, refried beans, and toppings meant to feed 2, but really feeds 4 for just $25?? PLUS, the chips and fresh salsa they bring you while you're waiting!

The only con I can see is that they are in need of a fresh coat of paint to bring some life into the space.

As they bring the menus they also give you a basket full of warm chips with salsa (spicy is very spicy but good, I mixed two sauces). The menu is full of options like vegetarian, seafood, and much more. We went in an hour before closing and felt bad but people were keep coming in after us. The dishes were delicious and the portions were also very generous. Pictures are cheese enchilada, rice, bean, fish tacos, and chips.

Our favorite Mexican place in Charlottesville, hands down.

Great food, excellent prices, stellar and consistent staff. What more could you ask for?

Surprisingly good food. At first glance you will think nothing of this place, but the food was pretty darn good. I recommend the chiliquilles or the Jalisco style nachos. The margaritas are medium sized but quite potent.

This is one of my favorite places to dine, there is always a friendly face to greet you and take you to a seat. It is not often I have such an amazing dinning experience but El Puerto has not failed to deliver a single handed best experience I’ve had at a Mexican restaurant in Charlottesville. I will be back many times to enjoy their food and enjoy the experience of dining with our friends at El Puerto
